Strong liquidity (current assets/current liabilities ≈ 916/239 = 3.8) and low leverage (total liabilities/assets ≈ 290/1,349 = 0.22) support near-term credit resilience, alongside solid profitability (net income 337M; EBIT 90M on revenue 626M). DECISION: A-
